messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Implemented Neon Pairs, including deterministic board codes, snapshot import/export, the replay CLI, saved size and best scores, keyboard navigation, and the documented responsive layouts.

**Offline game:** [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html)

**Verification:** `npm ci`, typecheck, build, and all tests passed: 15 unit tests and 6 browser journeys. The built HTML was opened from disk without network access. The tested combination was Node 26.12.1, npm 11.20.0, Playwright 1.64.1, and Chromium 156.0.8078.4.

The automated accessibility-tree record is [keyboard-journey.aria.txt](/work/evidence/keyboard-journey.aria.txt). No screen reader was used.
